messages:
ayan: Quick sync  we need owners for customer comms after the inference degradation. Who takes: 72h customer note, statuspage copy, RCA redaction rules, and follow-up verification?
lucy: I can draft the 72h note (short impact + next steps). Target +48h.
marc: I'll do the statuspage blurb and confirm timestamps with infra. Target +24h.
legal: We'll review redaction but initial rules: no IPs, mask customer IDs, no verbatim stack traces; enterprise RCAs via support + legal (NDA as needed).
infra-bot: Postmortem page created: https://redwood/pms/1843219999 (editable)
ayan: Good. Proposed deadlines: statuspage (marc) +24h, 72h note (lucy) +48h, redaction checklist (legal) +36h, verification plan (infra) +7d.
lucy: For customer wording, prefer "service impact" over technical terms like "throttling". Keep it short and neutral.
marc: Draft status copy suggestion:
```
We experienced a temporary service impact affecting a subset of inference requests between 08:10-08:35 UTC. The issue has been mitigated and normal service has resumed. We are investigating and will provide updates.
```
legal: Approve that tone. If customers request the full RCA, route through support + legal for redaction review.
ayan: I'll open tracker items now and tag as recurring-pattern since platform team saw a similar regression last month. Platform-eng should get the recurrence memo.
marc: Adding actions to tracker: ACTION-7120 statuspage (marc) +24h; ACTION-7121 72h note (lucy) +48h; ACTION-7122 redaction checklist (legal) +36h; ACTION-7123 verification plan (infra) +7d.
ayan: Final: compile drafts into the postmortem and assign reviewers. Please update the tracker when starting work. :thumbsup:
